(04) How we work

From attention to clients.

Every retainer runs the same four steps. You see the funnel fill in your report every week.

  1. 01

    AuditWeek 1

    We study your site, ads and competitors and find the fastest wins.

  2. 02

    LaunchWeek 2–3

    Campaigns, content and fixes go live.

  3. 03

    OptimiseMonth 2

    We test creatives, keywords and pages every week.

  4. 04

    ScaleMonth 3+

    We put more budget and content behind what works.
